Home / Perspectives

Others will read it, too.

Others will read our repositories.

Published edition data are not the only interesting reading. Working repositories can be fascinating sources, preserving traces of decisions, collaboration, detours and changes.

There are legitimate reasons to read these sources with editorial care: joining a team, reviewing a project or researching editorial practice. Such readings may reveal connections we did not notice while working. AI-assisted analysis can also open up unexpected perspectives.

We present four selected perspectives. If you are planning to use Git, consider these viewpoints: what should others be able to understand? What may they read and analyse? And which conclusions do the recorded traces actually support?
